scope_note: A new section in the coverage-completion round the repository owner authorised on 2026-09-14 (audits/coverage/2026-09-14/STUDY-GUIDE-COVERAGE-COMPLETION-PLAN.json); no earlier audit binds it. The declared scope was widened to 247 CMR 9.10 automated pharmacy systems and Board Policy 2022-07, the devices from which patients collect filled prescriptions, which no other section teaches, and to the Poison Prevention Packaging Act for dispensed drugs. Two planned records misstate Board policy and were replaced before freezing: MA-ADD-CORE (implies facility approval is always required, where Policy 2019-02 has the facility determine whether approval is required) by MA-ADD-POLICY-REQUIREMENTS, and MA-ADD-TECH ("sealed" where Policy 2023-08 says "without further manipulation") by MA-ADD-TECH-STOCKING-CONDITIONS. MA-COMPLIANCE-PACKAGING-STANDARDS and MA-REUSABLE-DOSAGE-PLANNER stay beside new rules for the paragraphs they omit. Added for in-scope law no record carried: MA-COMPLIANCE-PACKAGING-DESIGN-AND-FILL, MA-SINGLE-DRUG-SINGLE-DOSE-PACKAGING, MA-MULTI-DRUG-SINGLE-DOSE-LIMITS, MA-MULTI-DRUG-SINGLE-DOSE-RETURN-REPACKAGING, MA-COMPLIANCE-PACKAGING-LABEL (247 CMR 9.08), MA-COMPLIANCE-PACKAGING-POLICY-ADDITIONS (Policy 2023-01), MA-REUSABLE-DOSAGE-PLANNER-LABEL (9.07(5)), MA-AUTOMATED-PHARMACY-SYSTEM (9.10), MA-APS-BOARD-POLICY (Policy 2022-07), FED-PPPA-RX-SPECIAL-PACKAGING, FED-PPPA-CONVENTIONAL-PACKAGING-REQUEST (15 U.S.C. 1471-1476, 16 CFR part 1700), FED-PPPA-CPSC-DISPENSER-GUIDANCE (Commission staff guidance) and MA-NO-STATE-DISPENSED-DRUG-SPECIAL-PACKAGING, which records a dated search result rather than a rule of law. MA-SCHEDULE-VI and MA-PMP-DISPENSER-REPORTING-GUIDE are cited for the Schedule VI and gabapentin reporting points. The section flags as arguable, with a safe course, where Board policies go beyond or sit uneasily with the regulations (trainee stocking without direct supervision, Schedule II loading, the Policy 2022-07 consultation description, whether a planner request is a request for conventional packaging). Scope gate: every signal declined. They are M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 21 label, schedule and excepted-preparation neighbours taught in other sections, prescription monitoring program records taught in SG-RX-VALIDITY-AND-OPIOID-SAFETY, and MA-ADD-TECH, the record replaced above. Practice links: 22 questions (MA-Q-0132 to MA-Q-0135, MA-Q-0137 to MA-Q-0140, MA-Q-0169, MA-Q-0170, MA-Q-0179 to MA-Q-0184, MA-Q-0202, MA-Q-0203, MA-Q-0210, MA-Q-0392, MA-Q-0394 and MA-Q-0395); MA-Q-0131 and MA-Q-0136 left the links because their keys misstate Policy 2019-02 and the loading rules.
